title: Business
subtitle: Your business's master data: legal identity, addresses, bank accounts, commercial defaults, licences and memberships. They appear on contracts, invoices and the QR-bill.
loadError: The business data could not be loaded.

errors.managerOnly: Only a manager of this business changes its master data.
errors.conflict: The data was changed elsewhere in the meantime. Reload the page and enter your change again.
errors.uidTaken: This UID already belongs to another business.
errors.confirmationRequired: A change of the legal name, UID or VAT needs your confirmation.
errors.unknownReferenceCode: This value is not in the list.
errors.qrReferenceNeedsQrIban: The QR reference needs a QR-IBAN. Enter the QR-IBAN or choose another reference type.
errors.qrIbanNeedsQrReference: A QR-IBAN is only used with the QR reference. Remove the QR-IBAN or choose the QR reference.
errors.creditorPrefixNeedsScor: A reference prefix applies to the structured creditor reference (SCOR) only.
errors.defaultConflict: Another account became the invoice account in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
errors.bankingManagerOnly: Only a manager of this business changes the bank accounts.

legal.title: Legal identity
legal.legalName: Legal name (as in the commercial register)
legal.tradeNameHint: What the sign says – for marketing and price tags.
legal.uidHint: Swiss enterprise identification number, e.g. CHE-123.456.789.
legal.confirmHint: The legal name, UID and VAT details appear on every contract and invoice. The change is recorded under your name.
legal.confirmLabel: I confirm these details match the commercial register.
legal.confirmFirst: Confirm the change of legal identity.
legal.auditNotePlaceholder: e.g. renamed per commercial register entry of 1 October

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.countryHint: Country code, e.g. CH, DE, LI.
addresses.correspondenceDiffers: Post goes to an address other than the registered seat
addresses.billingDiffers: Nexotec's invoices go to another address (e.g. the group's accounting office)

addressEntry.title: Address entry
addressEntry.enabledHint: While an address is entered, the typed address text is sent to Google – never the name or any other customer data. Only the chosen address is stored; every field stays editable.
addressEntry.unavailable: No Google key is configured on this installation. Suggestions appear once Nexotec has configured it.

banking.title: Bank accounts
banking.deleteConfirm: The account {{iban}} will be removed. Invoices that already name it stay as they are.
banking.noneYet: No bank account yet. Without an invoice account no invoice can be issued.
banking.noDefault: No account is set as the invoice account. Choose the one that appears on invoices and the QR-bill.

fields.ibanHint: Checked on save. A QR-IBAN goes into the QR-IBAN field.
fields.qrReferenceTypeHint: The QR reference needs a QR-IBAN; the creditor reference and "none" use the ordinary IBAN.
fields.creditorReferencePrefixHint: So incoming payments (camt.054) are matched automatically.
fields.label: Label
fields.isDefaultHint: Appears on invoices and the QR-bill. At most one – you choose it explicitly.

fiscal.title: Commercial and fiscal defaults
fiscal.hint: Offers, contracts, invoices and the accounting export inherit these. Each has a neutral starting value.
fiscal.vatRateHint: The one rate the VAT line on documents is computed with.
fiscal.accountingSystemHint: The name only – access is set up under Integrations.
fiscal.periodLockHint: Nobody writes inside a locked period – no manager either.

licences.title: Licences and memberships
licences.haendlerschildHint: Your business's U plates with issuing canton and expiry of the licence – for test drives and transfers.
licences.astraHint: Prerequisite for the vehicle registry connection.

security.title: Security
security.mfaEnforced: Require a second factor for every user
security.mfaEnforcedHint: Every user of this business signs in with an authenticator app or a passkey in addition to the password. Nexotec staff always do.
security.idleMinutesHint: Between {{min, number}} and {{max, number}} minutes. Leave empty for Nexotec's value.
security.absoluteHoursHint: Between {{min, number}} and {{max, number}} hours from sign-in. Every session ends at midnight at the latest.
security.appliesFromNextSignIn: The rules apply to every sign-in from now on; sessions already running keep their limits until the next sign-in or the next switch of business.

errors.idleOutOfBounds: Sign-out after inactivity must be between 15 and 120 minutes.
errors.absoluteOutOfBounds: The longest session must be between 1 and 12 hours.

copyConfiguration.title: Copy configuration from …
copyConfiguration.intro: Copy standard texts, the document template's header notes, number-range patterns and contact groups once from another business you also manage. The copies then belong to this business; later changes in the other business have no effect here.

subsetHint.standard_texts: The business's own and adapted texts, without site variants. A text this business already has is overwritten. The approval of WhatsApp templates is never copied; an overwritten template must be submitted again.
subsetHint.document_template: The documents' header note, per language. Where the other business has none in a language, this one's stays as it is.
subsetHint.number_ranges: Pattern, start value and yearly reset of the modules this business uses. Counters are never copied; a range that has already issued a number stays as it is.
subsetHint.contact_groups: The contact groups the other business uses are switched on here. No group is switched off.

copyConfiguration.confirmNote: Nothing is saved until you confirm. The copy is recorded in the audit log.
copyConfiguration.done: Copied from {{source}}: {{created, number}} new, {{overwritten, number}} overwritten, {{skipped, number}} skipped.
copyConfiguration.nothing: The chosen business has nothing to copy for this.

reason.default_replaced: Replaces the current default text for this place; that text is kept but is no longer preselected.
reason.number_range_frozen: This range has already issued a number and is frozen.
reason.number_pattern_location_code_missing: No site of this business has a code for {location_code}.
reason.number_range_counter_too_short: The next counter does not fit the pattern.
reason.standard_text_placeholder_invalid: The text contains a placeholder that is no longer valid.
reason.standard_text_seed_language_missing: This text's template no longer exists in this language.
reason.whatsapp_approval_reset: The WhatsApp template must be submitted for approval again.
reason.contact_group_inactive: Nexotec has withdrawn this contact group.

statusRefusals.status_required: A business's status cannot be empty.
statusRefusals.status_not_patchable: A business's status is not changed here: activation and offboarding are procedures of their own.
statusRefusals.use_activation_procedure: A business becomes active through its activation, not through this change.
statusRefusals.use_offboarding_procedure: A business is offboarded through «Offboard a business», not through this change.
statusRefusals.status_transition_not_allowed: This status change is not possible here.
